design_philosophy: Focused, executive, calm institutional design. Optimize for clarity, progressive disclosure, and task completion. High signal-to-noise ratio. Emulate Mercado Pago's clean layout, crisp borders, and purposeful use of blue.

font_family.heading: Inter, sans-serif
font_family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl overflow-hidden
cards.header: px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between

buttons.primary: bg-[#009EE3] text-white hover:bg-[#008CC9] font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-[#009EE3] hover:bg-[#009EE3]/10 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors

status_badges.dot_pattern: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700
status_badges.pill_pattern: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

alerts.critical: bg-red-50 border-l-4 border-red-500 p-4 flex gap-3 rounded-r-lg
alerts.warning: bg-amber-50 border-l-4 border-amber-500 p-4 flex gap-3 rounded-r-lg
alerts.info: bg-blue-50 border-l-4 border-[#009EE3] p-4 flex gap-3 rounded-r-lg

tabs.list: flex border-b border-slate-200 w-full overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar
tabs.trigger: px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 border-b-2 border-transparent transition-colors whitespace-nowrap

A_Header_Sticky.content: Legajo ID (a), Property Type (a), Status Badge (b), Top Actions (k)
A_Header_Sticky.instructions: Keep it ultra-compact. ID in mono font. 'Programar firma' as the only solid blue CTA. Sticky top so actions are always available.

B_Alerts_Banner.instructions: Render ONLY if there are pending alerts. Do not show empty states. Use full-width banners just below the header. Include the 'Resolver' action explicitly.

C_Executive_Snapshot.instructions: A grid of 3-4 clean cards. Card 1: Address & Precio. Card 2: Estado Actual (dot pattern) & Próxima Acción. Card 3: Firma Tentativa. Card 4: Responsables. Demote complex stepper, use a text-based phase indicator (e.g., 'Fase 3 de 5: Análisis').

D_Main_Content_Tabs.content: Resumen, Partes (h), Inmueble (g), Documentos (i, j), Timeline (j)
D_Main_Content_Tabs.instructions: This is the progressive disclosure engine. Hide the heavy data here. Default tab is 'Resumen'. Move the exhaustive lists (Matrícula, Partida, full DNI details) to the 'Inmueble & Partes' tab. Move the 5-phase visual stepper to the 'Timeline' tab.

micro_interactions.hover: Subtle background color shifts (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50 for table rows), text color darkening.
micro_interactions.focus: Clear ring using the primary blue (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#009EE3] focus-visible:ring-offset-1).

implementation_notes.demote_hide: Demoted the visual 5-step progress bar from the hero section (moved to Timeline/Detalle). Hid full party details (DNI, contact) behind a tab. Removed repetitive status blocks (Estado is shown once in header, detailed once in Snapshot).
implementation_notes.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5. Sizes 16px to 20px.
implementation_notes.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='tab-documentos', data-testid='btn-programar-firma').

do_not_list: DO NOT use purple, violet, or teal anywhere. Rely on MP Blue (#009EE3), white, and slate grays.
DO NOT use heavy gradients or glassmorphism. Keep cards solid white with thin 1px #e2e8f0 borders.
DO NOT center-align data. Use left-alignment for forms and details, tabular numbers for currency.
DO NOT dump all property identifiers (Matrícula, Partida) in the hero. They belong in a dedicated tab/card.
DO NOT use large text shadows or box-shadows. Stick to Tailwind's shadow-sm for cards.
DO NOT use standard HTML inputs/selects; use Shadcn styled versions with strict 1px borders.
